peers.name: Playback Health
peers.description: Playback Health transforms healthcare communication and documentation by empowering clinicians and patients. Studies show doctors spend more time on administrative tasks than on direct patient care. This leads to exhaustion, dissatisfaction, and ultimately, a high rate of burnout and turnover among medical professionals. This administrative burden detracts from the true purpose of medicine and limits the number of patients a clinician can effectively see.2. Poor Patient Comprehension and Adherence to Care Plans: Patients often leave medical appointments feeling overwhelmed, confused by medical jargon, and unable to recall or fully understand critical information about their diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up instructions.
